problem.statement: Solo travellers may need to cancel bookings without contacting support.

requirements.title: Online cancellation
requirements.statement: The booking page offers a cancel action.
acceptance_criteria: The cancel action is visible for an eligible booking.

requirements.title: Refund timing
requirements.statement: The traveller is told when the refund will arrive.
acceptance_criteria: The expected refund window is shown.

evidence.claim: The original request did not specify refund timing.

assumptions.statement: Existing booking data contains the cancellation policy.

risks.statement: Refund timing may depend on a provider that the customer does not see.
risks.mitigation: Show a range and mark provider timing as an unresolved dependency until confirmed.

decisions.question: Should the customer see a precise refund date or a range?

unknowns.question: Which refund window applies to flexible and non-flexible fares?
unknowns.impact: The acceptance criterion for refund timing cannot be finalised.

sources.excerpt: The customer asked for online cancellation but did not describe refund policy details.
